system.description:
Most vampires find animal blood thin, tasteless and rather beneath them; you have learned to wring real sustenance from such humble vessels.

Once learned, every Blood Trait you gain from animals counts as two. However, after every third feeding on animal blood you must win a Static Mental Challenge whenever human or Kindred blood is offered, or frenzy and drain the vessel dry. The challenge grows harder by three extra Traits bid at each further third feeding (sixth, ninth, and so on) until you finally frenzy and slake your thirst, which resets the count. The power grants no bonus Blood Traits from supernatural creatures in animal form.
system.duration: Permanent, until you frenzy and feed
